name: Karam Sheltek PN521 HDPE Ratchet Industrial Safety Helmet
shortDescription: High-density UV-resistant HDPE industrial safety hard hat with 4-point textile cradle, wheel ratchet adjustment, and chin strap for construction head protection.
overview: The Karam Sheltek PN521 is an advanced industrial safety helmet designed to provide uncompromising head impact and penetration protection on construction sites and factory floors. Molded from special high-density UV-stabilized polyethylene (HDPE), the shell features a pronounced central reinforcing ridge that dissipates vertical impact energy away from the crown of the head. It is fitted with a 4-point cross-woven textile suspension cradle and a smooth-operating rear wheel ratchet mechanism that enables instant single-handed size adjustment from 52 to 64 cm.
keyFeatures: Molded from special grade UV-resistant high-density polyethylene (HDPE)
High impact absorption and penetration resistance conforming to IS 2925 and EN 397
4-point cross textile webbing suspension harness distributes shock evenly
Smooth wheel ratchet adjustment mechanism for secure, tailored custom fit (52-64 cm)
Universal side slots accept standard earmuffs, welding shields, and face visors
Cushioned brushed fabric sweatband absorbs perspiration across the forehead
Includes adjustable elastic chin strap with chin cup for high-wind stability

specifications.Color: White (Also available in Yellow, Blue, Red, Green)

applications: Multi-story civil and industrial building construction
Oil refineries, petrochemical plants, and offshore rigs
Heavy manufacturing, shipbuilding, and dockyard facilities
